name: labs/freespace__pyapt
title: Thorlabs APT stage controller (pyapt)
intro: Thorlabs APT stage controller (pyapt), adapted from freespace/pyapt. It reads `velocity`, `moving`, `homed`, `forward_limit_active` and 4 more; sets `position`, `soft_limits`, `maximum_velocity` and `acceleration`; runs `home`, `move_relative` and `stop_motion`. `home`: drive axes to their declared home position or reference switch, establishing the coordinate reference needed by other motion capabilities. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/freespace__pyapt --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/freespace__pyapt --backend fake --mcp
